articles.title: ABVP Leaders Caught Filming Girls Changing Clothes at Mandsaur College Fest — 3 Arrested, 1 run
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: MANDSAUR, MADHYA PRADESH — A shocking case of voyeurism has rocked Bhanpura Government College, where three student leaders linked to the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) were arrested for secretly recording female students changing clothes during a youth festival.

body.html:
MANDSAUR, MADHYA PRADESH — A shocking case of voyeurism has rocked Bhanpura Government College, where three student leaders linked to the Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) were arrested for secretly recording female students changing clothes during a youth festival.

The incident took place on October 14, 2025, when girl students preparing for cultural performances noticed someone trying to capture photos through a window. They immediately alerted the acting principal, Dr. Preeti Pancholi, who filed a written complaint with the police.

Upon reviewing the CCTV footage, police found that four male students had attempted to peek into the girls’ changing area — one of them even stood on another’s shoulders to take photos.

Based on the evidence, a case was registered under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) concerning voyeurism and privacy violations.

The arrested accused have been identified as Umesh Joshi (ABVP city secretary), Ajay Goud (co-college head), and Himanshu Bairagi (activist). A fourth student is still absconding. Police have seized their mobile phones for forensic analysis to check if the recordings were saved or shared.

Mandsaur SP Vinod Meena confirmed the arrests and said further action would follow once the forensic reports are received. Meanwhile, ABVP district convenor Chandraraj Pawar stated that Umesh Joshi has been suspended and an internal inquiry has been launched.

The incident has sparked widespread outrage, with many calling it a disgraceful breach of privacy and demanding stricter action against the accused.

articles.title: Rs 5 Crore Cash, Mercedes, Audi Seized! CBI Arrests Punjab DIG Harcharan Singh Bhullar in Massive
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chandigarh: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested DIG Harcharan Singh Bhullar, a 2009-batch IPS officer posted in Ropar Range, Punjab, on corruption charges after recovering nearly Rs 5 crore in cash, luxury cars, gold, and expensive watches during raids at his...

body.html:
Chandigarh: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has arrested DIG Harcharan Singh Bhullar, a 2009-batch IPS officer posted in Ropar Range, Punjab, on corruption charges after recovering nearly Rs 5 crore in cash, luxury cars, gold, and expensive watches during raids at his residences.

Bhullar was arrested along with his alleged aide, Krishna, who acted as a middleman. According to the CBI FIR, the officer demanded Rs 8 lakh and monthly “settlement payments” from a scrap dealer in Fatehgarh Sahib to avoid implicating him in a false case.

A trap was laid in Chandigarh’s Sector 21, where Krishna was caught red-handed accepting Rs 8 lakh on Bhullar’s behalf. Soon after, Bhullar was arrested from his Mohali office following a controlled phone call confirming his involvement.

Searches at his Ropar, Mohali, and Chandigarh residences led to the seizure of Rs 5 crore in cash, 1.5 kg of gold, property papers, two luxury cars (Mercedes and Audi), 22 premium watches, and several firearms. An additional Rs 21 lakh was recovered from Krishna’s home.

The CBI stated that both accused have been remanded in custody as further investigations into Bhullar’s assets and possible money laundering are underway.

Bhullar, son of former Punjab DGP MS Bhullar, has previously held key posts including DIG Patiala Range and Joint Director, Vigilance Bureau. He also led an SIT that probed the drug case against SAD leader Bikram Singh Majithia in 2021.

articles.title: Moradabad Murder Shock: Wife, Lover Arrested for Killing Husband Over Illicit Affair
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Moradabad, UP — In a shocking case of betrayal, police have solved the murder of Veerpal, a resident of Alehdadpur Deva Nagla village under Bilari police station limits.

body.html:
Moradabad, UP — In a shocking case of betrayal, police have solved the murder of Veerpal, a resident of Alehdadpur Deva Nagla village under Bilari police station limits. The investigation revealed that Veerpal’s wife, Sunita, conspired with her lover Ashish alias Anshu to kill her husband, as he had become an obstacle in their illicit relationship.

The murder came to light when Veerpal’s body was found in his own paddy field on Monday morning. Acting on the information given by village head representative Bhup Singh, the police reached the spot, took the body into custody, and sent it for post-mortem. The report confirmed that Veerpal had been strangled to death.

Following a complaint filed by Veerpal’s brother, Kunwarpal, the police registered a case against Sunita and her lover Anshu. Both were arrested within hours and produced in court, from where they were sent to jail.

During interrogation, Anshu confessed to the crime, admitting that he strangled Veerpal while he was asleep in the field around 1 a.m. on October 12. He revealed that Sunita had encouraged him, saying she would only be with him if her husband was “out of the way.” After killing Veerpal, Anshu went to Sunita’s house and informed her of the act.

Police investigations revealed that Anshu had been living with his mother Pushpalata at his maternal home since childhood, which is in the same family as the deceased. The village head is his maternal aunt. Locals claimed that despite being distantly related, Sunita and Anshu were involved in an affair despite a 12-year age gap between them.

Villagers grew suspicious when Sunita opposed informing the police about her husband’s death, fearing a post-mortem would “spoil his ashes.” On Tuesday morning, when she attempted to flee the village on her nephew’s bike, residents caught her and handed her over to the police.

Both accused — Sunita and Anshu — are now behind bars, and the murder case has sent shockwaves across Moradabad district.

articles.title: Temple Vandalism in Saharanpur Sparks Communal Row — SP MP Iqra Hasan
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A temple vandalism case in Chakur (Chhapur) village of Saharanpur district, under the Kairana Lok Sabha constituency, has escalated into a communal and political flashpoint.

body.html:
A temple vandalism case in Chakur (Chhapur) village of Saharanpur district, under the Kairana Lok Sabha constituency, has escalated into a communal and political flashpoint. Earlier this month, idols inside a Shiva temple were found vandalized, triggering anger among locals and protests led by groups like the Hindu Suraksha Seva Sangh.

During one such protest, Samajwadi Party MP Iqra Hasan, who represents Kairana, visited the village to appeal for peace and demand strict punishment for those behind the act. However, Iqra alleged that instead of cooperation, she faced verbal abuse from some BJP supporters.

She accused a close aide of former BJP MP Pradeep Chaudhary of calling her “Mulli” and “terrorist”, and of insulting her late father and brother. Videos circulating online show Iqra visibly emotional while condemning hate politics, as police personnel stood by.

The MP also claimed that while a complaint was filed, the accused were granted bail shortly after, calling the move “lenient” and “insensitive.” She further alleged that the insults were meant to provoke communal tensions and questioned whether the former MP would publicly condemn the act.

Police confirmed registering a case under the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for vandalism and related offenses, and said that investigations into both the temple defacement and the protest incidents are ongoing.

The incident has drawn national attention, with Iqra Hasan’s remarks being shared widely as an example of growing polarization in western Uttar Pradesh.

articles.title: Groom’s Final Words: ‘Only Charu Will Be Responsible for My Death’ — Moradabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Moradabad: A shocking case of alleged betrayal in love has shaken the Civil Lines area of Moradabad, where 23-year-old Aniket, a resident of Adarsh Colony, ended his life by consuming poison after his fiancée, Charu, allegedly eloped with her lover.

body.html:
Moradabad: A shocking case of alleged betrayal in love has shaken the Civil Lines area of Moradabad, where 23-year-old Aniket, a resident of Adarsh Colony, ended his life by consuming poison after his fiancée, Charu, allegedly eloped with her lover.

Aniket’s family found him dead at home, and initially performed the last rites without informing the police. Days later, while checking his phone, the family discovered an 18-second suicide video, in which Aniket can be heard saying, “Only Charu will be responsible for my death… I cannot live anymore.”

Following the discovery, the family lodged a formal complaint at the Civil Lines police station, demanding strict action against the woman. Police have registered the case and begun an investigation.

According to reports, Aniket was preparing for a government job and had become emotionally disturbed after his fiancée left with her lover. His mother also alleged that the woman took away jewellery and items given during their engagement.

The incident has sparked debate in the city over rising cases of youth suicides linked to relationship distress and the failure of families to identify emotional warning signs in time.
